name: wafflebase
description: Find, read, create, edit and organize Wafflebase sheets, docs, slides and notes from Claude Code, through the wafflebase CLI.

auto_allow_reads.title: Auto-allow read-only commands
auto_allow_reads.description: Run a single plain read-only wafflebase command (list, get, content, …) without asking. Off by default: an allowed call trusts that `wafflebase` in the persistent shell is still the real CLI, which an earlier command could have changed.

auto_approve_writes.title: Auto-approve document writes
auto_approve_writes.description: Run wafflebase commands that edit documents without asking first. Deletes, whole-document replaces, local file reads and writes, credential and sharing changes, and --server/--api-key overrides always ask.
